subject: CAIQ: privileged access cross-reference and evidence catalog
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ: privileged access cross-reference and evidence catalog

Hi team,

PioneerHealth (security contact: Lena Ortiz) asked for a compact CAIQ crosswalk focused only on privileged access controls and the evidence artifacts we can share for each control. They flagged four subcontrols they want demonstrated for a live review next week: IAM-4 (privileged roles), LOG-2 (privileged session logging), CM-3 (change approvals for elevated roles), and AUD-1 (access reviews).

I attached a working spreadsheet (privileged_access_matrix.xlsx) with my initial mapping to CSA/CAIQ identifiers and a recommended exposure level (shareable, redacted, internal-only). Please do the following by EOD today: 
- Priyom: confirm the mapping for LOG-2 and point me to the sample S3 logs/Dynamo exports we can provide (or paste the Drive path).
- Marcus: add a one-line explanation and a sample artifact for CM-3 (change approvals) — ideally a ticket link or an exported approval audit.
- Kimberly: sanity-check the exposure recommendations; Pioneer prefers examples they can validate without an NDA escalation.

Goal: deliver a compact two-page PDF they can use for the review call on Wed 31 Aug. If we can produce a single redacted log sample (last 7 days) and a signed change approval PDF, that's likely sufficient.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: privileged_access_matrix.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: privileged access cross-reference and evidence catalog

On 2027-08-29 Olga Petrov wrote:
> PioneerHealth (security contact: Lena Ortiz) asked for a compact CAIQ crosswalk focused only on privileged access controls...

Thanks, Olga — noted. For LOG-2 I mapped the CAIQ entry to our internal event names (privilege_grant, privilege_escalation, sudo_session_start). The redacted log sample lives in the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cPrivAccessEvidence (folder "LOG-2_samples"). I will export the last 7 days (obfuscated IPs) and attach a brief readme explaining column meanings.

Action: I'll upload a redacted CSV and a short md file by 1600 PT. Marcus — can you confirm the ticket format we should export for CM-3? We have two change workflows (JIRA for infra, ServiceNow for access requests); Pioneer explicitly asked for the approval artifacts showing approver, timestamp, and justification.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Security Engineer, Evidence Automation
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-29T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: privileged access cross-reference and evidence catalog

Priyom / Olga — I pulled the CM-3 artifacts. We have a recent change (CHG-2027-482) with full approval trail in ServiceNow; I exported the approval PDF and added a one-page summary in the Drive folder (linked below). The export shows approver name, role, timestamp, and approval comment. For the review packet I recommend we include: 
- ServiceNow approval PDF (redact internal ticket IDs if required)
- Redacted CSV of privilege session starts (LOG-2)
- Short narrative tying the artifacts to the CAIQ control IDs (one paragraph per control)

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cPrivAccessEvidence (see folder "CM-3_approvals").

I attached a light zip of samples (caiq_evidence_samples.zip) to my local copy; I'll move the export to the shared Drive after a quick scrub.

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiq_evidence_samples.zip
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: (none)
Date: 2027-08-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: privileged access cross-reference and evidence catalog

Hi Olga — thanks to you and the team for the fast turnaround. The crosswalk looks sensible; we'll want a single redacted session log sample and the ServiceNow approval PDF (redacted ticket IDs) for our validation. A couple of quick asks before the call on Wed: 

1) Can you confirm whether the exported sessions include MFA challenge results for privileged sessions (we're OK with a yes/no and a short note on retention windows)?
2) For the change approval, can you provide the approval timestamp in ISO format (UTC) — our auditor tool ingests timestamps and we need UTC.

If it's easier, let's do a brief 20-minute sync tomorrow morning (Tue 30 Aug 10:00 AM ET) to walk through the artifacts. I'm flexible otherwise and can join the Wed slot if needed.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Security Lead, PioneerHealth
lena@pioneerhealth.com
